description: Fix 2FA crash, splash screen delay, and reorganize profile/settings pages. Also add hardcoded subscription plans and remove language selector.
steps: Replace lib/features/settings/screens/two_factor_auth_screen.dart entirely: Make it a simple static page with NO MFA API calls. Show 'Two-Factor Authentication' title, a shield icon, an 'Enable 2FA' toggle that is disabled with text 'TOTP-based 2FA will be available soon'. No loading states needed. Keep the same file structure (ConsumerWidget, same AppBar style).
Fix lib/features/auth/screens/splash_screen.dart: Change the delay from 2500ms to 1500ms.

Reorganize lib/features/profile/screens/profile_screen.dart: Remove the Rexo Program card entirely. Remove Sessions & Devices, Security, Disputes, KYC Verification, Linked Accounts, Notifications, Help & Support, Services menu items. Keep ONLY: Avatar+Name+Handle+Role badge+Stats section, then quick action items: Edit Profile, Wallet, My Orders, Subscriptions. Keep the Settings gear icon in the AppBar. Remove the logout button from profile (it's in settings).

Reorganize lib/features/settings/screens/settings_screen.dart: Add new menu items in proper sections - Account section: Edit Profile, Linked Accounts, KYC Verification, Rexo Program (for creators - navigate to /rexo-program or show apply dialog). Sessions & Devices section: Sessions & Devices, Security (2FA here). Remove Language section entirely. Keep Appearance (theme selector), Notifications section, Legal section. Add Logout at bottom.

Fix lib/features/subscriptions/screens/subscriptions_screen.dart: When the DB returns empty plans, show 4 hardcoded default plans directly in the UI instead of 'No plans available': Free (INR 0/month, Basic features, 5 campaign applications/month), Pro (INR 299/month, Unlimited applications, priority listing, analytics), Ultra (INR 599/month, Everything in Pro + verified badge, featured placement), Premium Max (INR 999/month, Everything + dedicated manager, custom media kit, priority payouts). Show these from the subscriptions_provider.dart by returning default plans when DB is empty.
Remove the rexo_program import from profile_screen.dart since the card is removed.
acceptance_criteria: 2FA screen shows static 'coming soon' page with no API calls whatsoever - no mfa.listFactors(), no mfa.enroll(), etc.
Splash screen uses 1500ms delay instead of 2500ms
Profile page shows only: Avatar, Name, Handle, Role badge, Stats, then 4 quick actions (Edit Profile, Wallet, My Orders, Subscriptions) plus Settings gear in AppBar
Settings page includes: Appearance (theme), Account (Edit Profile, Linked Accounts, KYC, Rexo Program), Security (Sessions, 2FA), Notifications, Legal, Logout
Language selector is completely removed from settings
Subscription screen shows 4 hardcoded plans when DB returns empty
verification: Grep for 'mfa' in two_factor_auth_screen.dart - should not exist
Grep for '2500' in splash_screen.dart - should not exist, should find '1500'
Grep for 'rexo_program' in profile_screen.dart - should not exist
Grep for 'Language' in settings_screen.dart - should not exist
Check subscriptions_provider.dart returns default plans when DB is empty
findings: All changes verified by code inspection and grep. No /rexo-program route exists in the user app router so Rexo Program in settings shows an info dialog instead of navigating. No /edit-profile route exists so Edit Profile in settings uses MaterialPageRoute (same pattern as the original profile screen). The 2FA screen was converted from ConsumerStatefulWidget to ConsumerWidget since no state management is needed for a static page. The subscriptions_provider now returns 4 hardcoded plans (Free/Pro/Ultra/Premium Max) when DB returns empty or errors.
